描述_EN: the metalworker created this double-sided design by making the chi beforehand, fixing them to the mould and then casting the molten bronze round them. this is an early form of bowl. the slender dragon is called a chi in chinese. it is also a rare example where the inlay decoration can be seen on the interior as well as the exterior.
描述_ZN: 金属工匠通过事先制作龙，将其固定在模具上，然后将熔化的青铜浇铸在龙的周围，创造了这种双面设计。 这是一个早期的碗的形式。 这条细长的龙在中文里被称为 "螭"。 这也是一个罕见的例子，在内部和外部都可以看到镶嵌的装饰。
